context: Kenji and Sakura collaborate on a writing-business event.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: さくらさん、一緒に、企画、出来て、嬉しい。
lines.en: Sakura-san, I'm really happy we get to work on this project together.
lines.style: Warm, genuine opening. Soft attack on her name. Let the gratitude sit in the voice—not effusive, just quietly pleased. Steady breath. A man expressing something true without needing it acknowledged.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 健次さん、こちらこそ、感謝。
lines.en: Kenji-san, the gratitude goes both ways.
lines.style: Soft, sincere response. No performance—matching his warmth with her own. Slight hesitation before speaking, like she's choosing her words carefully. Tender but grounded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: The way our dreams connect—it really does feel that way.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle, almost philosophical tone. He's reaching for something real here. Slow pace. Let each phrase breathe. Warm but reflective.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: I really do mean it—I'm going to give this everything.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Not loud—she doesn't need to be. A slight lean into the promise. Steady eye contact in the voice. Sincere without strain.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Deeper register. A beat before speaking, like he's finding the right words for something that matters. Warm composure. The kind of sincerity that only comes when you're not trying to impress anyone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Let's keep doing this together—for as long as we can.
lines.style: Soft, almost a promise made to herself as much as to him. Gentle trailing-off on the final particle. Warm but not sentimental. Grounded hope.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Closing breath. Quiet, full-stop sincerity. No elaboration needed. A man who means what he says. Soft exhale on the final word. Presence rather than performance.
